stewardship.deescalation: Not applicable - antibiotics were not started. Reassess if fever, focal chest signs, or worsening symptoms develop.
framework: Likely viral syndrome - antibiotics are unlikely to provide benefit and carry risk of adverse effects and resistance selection.
Sputum purulence alone does not justify antibiotics in the absence of fever, focal findings, or toxicity.
Symptomatic management (antitussives, hydration, rest) is appropriate; antibiotics should be withheld unless the clinical picture evolves.
